description: The racing line takes every ramp (issue #74): on every course it runs straight up each ramp (moving less than 0.5 m sideways from the leading edge to the lip), at least 1.2 m inside its sides, and from 15 m before the leading edge to the lip a rider's moves round other craft and its wander are kept on the ramp, 1.2 m inside its sides (ramp_line_check.gd).
